name: Order Status Communications Agent
headline: Align on the order story before the customer receives it
summary: Bring order, production, shipment, delay, recovery, owner, and channel context into one governed review and prepare consistent customer-message drafts without changing operations or sending updates.
capabilities: Identify delays proactively with automated monitoring
Generate recovery plans like schedule adjustments, alternative sourcing, and expedited logistics
Communicate updates across channels with consistent messaging
Tailor notifications and actions to the customer tier and preferences
value: Improves shared visibility into order, shipment, delay, recovery, ownership, and customer-preference context.
Accelerates preparation of consistent customer updates while keeping commitments grounded in approved evidence.
Protects customer trust by separating draft generation from order changes, schedule changes, logistics action, and outbound communication.

notice.text: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

scenarios.prompt: Draft the customer updates for approval, but do not send an email, portal update, EDI message, or Teams message.
